Vital Signs.description: Blood pressure, pulse, respiratory rate and body temperature, taken seated after 5 minutes of rest.

12-lead ECG.description: Resting 12-lead electrocardiogram, recorded supine after at least 5 minutes of rest.

PK sampling.description: Blood draw to measure the concentration of the study drug over time.

IP Administration.description: Dose of the investigational product. Timed assessments count from its start.
